gather.answer: Draft answer for 4.1.3, from the evidence found.

requirements.reason: The standard sets how accounts are created, changed and removed; the third-quarter record shows it done.

citations.quote: Accounts and passwords that a manufacturer sets in advance are disabled or given a new password before a system goes live.

requirements.reason: Every user has a personal account of their own.

citations.quote: Every user has a personal account of their own.

requirements.reason: Shared accounts only on read-only shop floor terminals, each listed with its purpose.

citations.quote: Accounts shared by several people are allowed only on shop floor terminals that show production data and change nothing, where knowing who did what is not needed; each such account is listed with its purpose.

requirements.reason: Accounts are disabled on the last working day; each leaver in the record was.

citations.quote: IT disables the accounts at the end of the last working day, and deletes them 90 days later.

requirements.reason: A six-monthly review is set, but no record shows one took place.

citations.quote: When someone leaves, all their rights end with their accounts under the user account standard.
Accounts are reviewed with the access rights in the periodic access review set out in the access rights policy.

requirements.reason: First passwords are handed over in person or sent to the work phone.

citations.quote: IT hands the first password to the new user in person, or sends it by text message to the user's work phone.

requirements.reason: The password rules cover secrecy, no writing down, changes on suspicion, no private reuse, first-login change and length.

citations.quote: The user must change it at the first login.

requirements.reason: A new account starts with the basic employee role.

citations.quote: A new account starts with the basic role every employee has, which gives email, the intranet and nothing more; further rights follow the access rights policy.

citations.quote: The line manager confirms the request, and IT creates the account only after both have signed off.

citations.quote: IT-4495 | Service provider, finished job | 2026-08-07 | 2026-08-07 | due 2026-11-05

requirements.reason: Users keep their tokens with them and have lost ones blocked.

citations.quote: Users keep their hardware token with them, never leave it in their laptop and tell IT at once if they lose it, so it can be blocked.
